paragraphs: I'm a 20-year-old full stack developer from Peru, currently studying at the Universidad Nacional de Cañete. I enjoy building responsive and user-friendly websites and applications, turning ideas into interactive digital experiences.
I love combining creativity with technology to develop projects that make an impact. I'm constantly learning new tools and frameworks to deliver modern and efficient solutions.
